description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'ConnectionSignalIdEnforcementFailedException' used for handling enforcement failures related to Signal IDs in a connectivity module of the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes inner builder classes, static factory methods, and references to other classes like DittoHeaders and JsonObject.

classes.name: ConnectionSignalIdEnforcementFailedException
classes.description: Custom final exception class for enforcement failures in Signal ID validation, extends DittoRuntimeException, immutable, with static factory methods and inner builder class.

classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class to construct instances of ConnectionSignalIdEnforcementFailedException with fluent API.
